cars.variant: Rapide — 1937 BYG 7 / chassis 12235/R, December 2020 driving reference
cars.specification_market: First-hand feature on road-registered BYG 7, chassis 12235/R, originally published in Octane 210, December 2020. Technical fields are the feature’s selected 1937 road reference, including its stated 4453 cc. Its questionable 885 kg figure, unverified acceleration/maximum-speed claims and claimed output are omitted. Owner-specific hand-control adaptations are not standard equipment; competition LG45s, modern Rapide conversions, V12s and other body styles do not add counts.
cars.summary: The LG45 Rapide expressed Lagonda’s prewar sporting ambition through Frank Feeley’s distinctive open coachwork and a developed Meadows six-cylinder engine. First-hand driving finds strong low-speed response and relaxed touring pace, while noting heavy steering and disturbance from poor road cambers. Its coherent sports-tourer design and engineering give it a clear identity beyond scarcity or price.

cars.generation: Original low-chassis S-Type production-road sports-tourer family
cars.variant: S-Type — early 1931 road programme, S91 historical catalogue reference
cars.specification_market: Early production S-Type road-tourer architecture described in the original 2022 inspected-car catalogue for road-registered 1931 S91, Sentinel. These are the catalogue’s standard-programme fields, not certification that every surviving example retains original parts. No modern continuation S314B, tuned 158 bhp competition engine, precise disputed displacement, maximum-speed slogan, unverified production total or universal rear-axle ratio is imported.
cars.summary: The S-Type gave Invicta a distinctive prewar sports-car identity by placing the rear axle above the chassis rails, lowering the body around a flexible Meadows six. Its emphasis on high-speed touring and effortless response was supported by developed braking and dual ignition. The low-chassis engineering and established sporting history justify one original road-family entry, without counting later continuations or racing conversions.
